metadata.title: Making-of — Micro-SaaS Studio Builder
metadata.description: 258 AI agents, 30 hours: how the demo was built by an orchestrator, spec by spec, then run through QA down to zero findings.

header.title: 258 AI agents, 30 hours, one platform in production.
header.description: An orchestrator split the design dossier into 28 specs, had them implemented in parallel in isolated worktrees, then ran QA until nothing was left to fix. A human validates at the key gates.

processSteps.heading: 00 · The process
processSteps.parallelNote: Steps 3 to 7 run in parallel, one spec per worktree, up to 12 agents at once.

timeline.heading: 01 · 02 · The two cycles, hour by hour
timeline.tagline: Each row is a worktree. Each bar, the life of a spec, from plan to merge.
timeline.qaPassTooltip: QA pass {pass} · {clock} · {count, plural, one {# finding} other {# findings}}
timeline.tableSummary: See the {count} worktrees as a table

implementation.heading: Cycle 1 · Implementation
implementation.summary: 28 specs in 11 hours, overnight. A spec starts as soon as its dependencies are merged.
implementation.point1: Frozen contracts first: types, data schema, base UI.
implementation.point2: Then 10 specs launched within the same minute, each in its own worktree and Postgres database.
implementation.point3: Plan, TDD, 5 specialized reviewers, /verify, PR, merge: 199 agents in total.

qa.heading: Cycle 2 · QA and fixes
qa.summary: 7 QA passes in a real browser, down to zero findings.
qa.findingsLabel: {count, plural, =0 {0 findings · 46/46 PASS} one {# finding} other {# findings}}
qa.footnote: Findings recorded per pass. 26 fixed via 16 follow-up specs, 3 dismissed by the human.
